annotations.title: List products in a Reddit catalog or product set

description: Read the products in a Reddit catalog (catalogId) or in one product set (productSetId), each with its title, price, availability, link, image and Reddit’s own review state and issues (the "reddit" block). Filter by approvalDecision (PENDING / APPROVED / REJECTED — REJECTED is how to find out why products are not serving), a search term, or specific ids. Paginated: pass the returned nextPageToken as pageToken. Read-only, free.

adAccountId.description: Reddit ad account id (a2_...); omit when only one is shared

approvalDecision.description: PENDING, APPROVED or REJECTED: filter by Reddit review state

productSetId.description: list the products in this product set instead of the whole catalog

search.description: text to match against product fields

name: list_reddit_ads_products
title: List products in a Reddit catalog or product set
